siteDescription: Legitimate paid-writing opportunities, practical writing guides, and BRYME's firsthand verification record.

adsense.note: Verification snippet live site-wide (2026-09-29). Ad UNITS remain unwired: nativeSlotId is empty. Keep Google-dashboard Auto ads OFF until approval. Ads must never resemble job cards or application buttons.

monetag.note: Owner-supplied Monetag site-verification token; emitted in the homepage head by scripts/inject-ads.py.

analytics.note: GA4 stream for thebryme.com, owner-supplied 2026-09-22. Injected into every page ahead of the AdSense loader by scripts/inject-analytics.py and emitted by the desk generators. Consent Mode v2 defaults are scoped to the EEA/UK/CH so visitors elsewhere are unaffected; Google's own CMP (AdSense > Privacy & messaging) sends the matching consent update once the owner enables it. Replaces the earlier published claim that these pages run no analytics.

pinterest.note: Owner-supplied Pinterest domain verification value. Emit on the canonical homepage only.

newsletter.note: mode 'mailto' = prefilled subscribe email to the mailbox (bootstrap). mode 'form' = endpoint must be the provider's form POST URL (Buttondown/MailerLite/ListMonk embeds work as-is with input name=email).

follow.note: Public channel URLs. A link renders only when set.

affiliate.note: No affiliate links exist yet. Flip enabled=true only after provider accounts are live AND docs/revenue-rails.md placement rules have been applied. The disclosure note renders automatically on guides tagged 'affiliate: true' in front matter.

adsterra.note: PRIMARY NETWORK (owner decision 2026-10-03, after the AdSense rejection). Live units 2026-10-03: placements.top (Native Banner), socialBar (Social Bar), displayBanner (classic atOptions banner). placements.middle still needs its own Native Banner unit from the Adsterra dashboard (paste key/host, rebuild). Adsterra's snippet contract is one container + invoke.js per unit. gateConsent: true keeps /assets/adsterra-loader.js in charge - immediate load outside the EEA/UK/CH, granted-consent load inside. All units load through the loader; nothing inline ever ships (CSP script-src 'self' https:, no unsafe-inline).

top.note: LIVE unit moved from bottom to top (owner decision 2026-10-03).

middle.note: Needs its own Adsterra Native Banner unit - paste key/host here.

bottom.note: Switched off - the live unit now runs at the top. Re-enable once this placement has its own dashboard unit.

socialBar.note: LIVE (owner unit, pasted 2026-10-03). External script only, loaded by /assets/adsterra-loader.js under the same consent gate; the floating widget mounts itself once the script runs.

displayBanner.note: LIVE (owner unit, pasted 2026-10-03): the classic atOptions 300x250 banner. The site CSP bans inline scripts, so the pasted snippet's inline atOptions config cannot ship verbatim; /assets/adsterra-loader.js sets the atOptions object inside a dedicated iframe and then loads invoke.js there, consent-gated like every other unit.

ads.position: adsterra native banner: top + middle + bottom of content pages; social bar before </body>; adsense native band is the future-pivot fallback and stays off while nativeSlotId is empty
